snp1.5:1.1: Cundasutta. "Pucchāmi muniṃ pahūtapaññaṃ iti Cundo kammāraputto Buddhaṃ dhammassāmiṃ vītataṇhaṃ dipaduttamaṃ sārathīnaṃ pavaraṃ: kati loke samaṇā, tad iṃgha brūhi". || ||
snp1.5:2.1: "Caturo samaṇā, na pañcamo 'tthi,| Cundā ti Bhagavā te te āvikaromi sakkhipuṭṭho: maggajino maggadesako ca, magge jīvati, yo ca maggadūsī". || ||
snp1.5:3.1: "Kam maggajinaṃ vadanti buddhā, iti Cundo kammāraputto maggajjhāyī kathaṃ atulyo hoti, magge jīvati me brūhi puṭṭho, atha me avikarohi maggadūsiṃ" || ||
snp1.5:4.1: "Yo tiṇṇakathaṃkatho visallo nibbānābhirato anānugiddho lokassa sadevakassa netā, tādiṃ maggajinaṃ vadanti buddhā. || ||
snp1.5:5.1: Paramaṃ paraman ti yo 'dha ñatvā akkhāti vibhajati idh' eva dhammaṃ, taṃ kaṃkhacchidaṃ muniṃ, {anejaṃ} dutiyaṃ bhikkhunam āhu maggadesiṃ. || ||
snp1.5:6.1: Yo dhammapade sudesite magge jīvati saññato satīmā anavajjapadāni sevamano, tatiyaṃ bhikkhunam āhu maggajīviṃ. || ||
snp1.5:7.1: Chadanaṃ katvāna subbatānaṃ {pakkhandī} kuladūsako pagabbho māyāvī asaññato palāpo patirūpena caraṃ, sa maggadūsī. || ||
snp1.5:8.1: Ete ca paṭivijjhi yo gahaṭṭho sutavā ariyasāvako sapañño| sabbe ne ‘tādisā' ti {ñatvā}, iti disvā na hāpeti tassa saddhā, -- kathaṃ hi duṭṭhena asampaduṭṭhaṃ suddhaṃ asuddhena samaṃ kareyyā" ti Cundasuttaṃ
